findings.summary: Boundary reading: src/fleet_graph/executors/agent_session.py gained an additive output_evidence attachment (_with_output_evidence, agent_session.py:78-93). The deadline stdout signal the spec's output_evidence demands exists only inside AgentSessionSeat.send, and the spec's '不改 agent-session/agent-runtime' names the external binary/repo (untouched); the change alters no TURN_TIMEOUT mechanism, budget, or protocol — existing timeout-path tests pass unchanged.
